subject: MAP: security gates sprint — DPA retention tradeoffs & evidence
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@horizonbank.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@horizonbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.l@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: security gates sprint — DPA retention tradeoffs & evidence

Hi Emily / Priya —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I'm attaching a draft mutual action plan that lays out the security/compliance gates we discussed (SOC 2 evidence handoff, SIG/CAIQ scope, and DPA retention windows). High-level asks:

- Can you confirm the maximum retention HorizonBank needs for production PII/transaction logs (your note said 12 months but procurement asked about longer windows)?
- Any special CAIQ sections you want us to prioritize for the eval (e.g., key lifecycle, encryption-at-rest, logging)?

Attached: MPA_DRAFT_20290514.pdf — includes milestones, owners, and a proposed DPA clause for retention tiers.

If this looks right, I'd propose we lock milestones and owners by Fri 17 May so procurement can route the DPA early next week.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
viv.k@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MPA_DRAFT_20290514.pdf (PDF)
From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@horizonbank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@horizonbank.com>, procurement@horizonbank.com
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: security gates sprint — DPA retention tradeoffs & evidence

Vivek —

Appreciate the draft. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) Retention: Our general policy for customer-facing transaction data is 13 months (rolling). For certain regulated product lines (mortgage/escrow) procurement may ask for up to 7 years of archival — however that's rare and we'd prefer shorter for sandbox/test telemetry.

2) SOC 2: We need SOC 2 Type II evidence (2024) or a SOC 2 bridge letter clarifying scope (encryption, access control, logging). Can you send the most recent attestation summary?

3) SIG/CAIQ: We'll share the internal priority matrix — on our side we care most about IAM, key management, and network segmentation. Can you confirm whether you will provide a CAIQ self-assessment or a completed SIG profile?

Procurement is looping in legal on the retention language; if you have suggested redline text it will speed review.

Emily Stone
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
HorizonBank
emily.stone@horizonbank.com | +1 212-555-0123
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.l@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP: security gates sprint — internal notes on retention options

Vivek / Marcus —

Drafted a response to Emily's questions and attached the docs they asked for. Key points to offer as negotiables:

- Retention tiers (recommended):
  * Tier A (transactional PII): default 13 months rolling; optional 7-year archival by request with escrow + separate SLA
  * Tier B (aggregates/telemetry): 90 days by default; 1-year option for analytics with explicit opt-in

- SOC 2: attach "SOC2_Type2_Summary_2024.pdf" (summary + control list). For legal: provide a short bridge letter if they need it before the full report distribution.

- SIG/CAIQ: We will provide both: a completed CAIQ workbook (SIG_CAIC_SelfAssessment.xlsx) and a redline summary of the areas we can commit to during evaluation. Note: kernel-level key management is limited in hosted mode; highlight Dedicated/Private options if they need customer-managed HSM.

Proposed DPA redline bullets to share: specific retention tiers, deletion triggers, export window (30 days), and escrow only for >2 year archival. I attached a draft redline doc (DPA_proposed_clause_redlines.docx).

I recommend we offer the 13-month default and have procurement escalate any 7-year asks to commercial/engineering for an architecture review.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.k@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_Summary_2024.pdf (PDF); SIG_CAIC_SelfAssessment.xlsx (XLSX); DPA_proposed_clause_redlines.docx (DOCX)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@horizonbank.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@horizonbank.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.k@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.l@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@horizonbank.com
Date: Wed, 15 May 2029 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: security gates sprint — DPA retention tradeoffs & evidence

Emily —

Thanks for the quick questions. Short answers and a proposed compromise below:

- Retention: We can accept 13 months rolling as the default for production PII/transaction logs. For the small subset of regulated data where HorizonBank requires longer archival, our proposal is: 7-year archival only with a formal request, escrow terms, and an engineering review to scope costs and exportability.

- SOC 2: Attached is a one-page summary of our SOC 2 Type II (2024) and a link to the full attestation request process; we will provide a bridge letter if legal needs interim confirmation.

- SIG/CAIQ: We will supply the filled CAIQ workbook and an executive summary that maps to your IAM/key-management/network segmentation asks. Note: customer-managed KMS is available on Private/Dedicated, we can flag that in the MAP as an optional acceptance criterion.

Next steps we propose:
1) You confirm the 13-month default and whether you want the 7-year archival clause to be "opt-in" per product line.
2) If agreed, we'll update the MPA milestones (SOC 2 evidence handoff, CAIQ delivery, DPA redline) and circulate for signature — target Fri 17 May to lock owners.

DocuSign link for a preliminary MPA/DPA combo will be posted in the drive once we have confirmation; see provisional link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/secure/HZN-1147

Thanks,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_Summary_2024.pdf (PDF); SIG_CAIC_SelfAssessment.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@horizonbank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@horizonbank.com>, procurement@horizonbank.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: security gates sprint — DPA retention tradeoffs & evidence

Vivek / Neha —

This looks good and aligns with our internal risk appetite. We confirm: 13 months rolling default; 7-year archival will be opt-in per product line and will go to procurement/legal for a manual approve with escrow terms.

Procurement will review your DPA redlines and the MPA milestone list you update; they plan to route DocuSign early next week. Can you please circulate the updated MPA with owners and a brief milestone checklist (SOC2 handoff date, CAIQ delivery date, DPA sign target)?

Once procurement gets the DocuSign packet we will route immediately. Thanks for being flexible on the retention tiers — that helps move this along.

Best,
Emily Stone
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
HorizonBank
